title: Correct period formula
description: Essential: Student must state or apply the small-angle pendulum period formula T = 2π√(L/g).

title: Numerical calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly compute T = 2π√(10/10) = 2π seconds ≈ 6.28 s.

title: Small-angle condition
description: Important: Student should acknowledge that the formula applies only under the small-angle approximation given.

title: Units in final answer
description: Important: Final answer must include correct time units (seconds or s).

title: Algebraic simplification
description: Optional: Student shows simplification √(L/g) = √(10/10) = 1 before multiplying by 2π.

title: Incorrect formula application
description: Pitfall: Using T = 2π√(g/L) or other incorrect formula variations.

title: Calculation error
description: Pitfall: Arithmetic mistake in evaluating √(L/g) or multiplying by 2π.
